title: Bitter Russian Tagine Chicken
description: A flavorful and savory chicken dish with a unique twist from Russian cuisine. The bitterness of the tagine pairs perfectly with the smokiness of the chicken.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken and cook until browned, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the tagine, chicken broth, and chicken breast. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 30-40 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the pot and let rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Strain the sauce and discard the solids. Serve the chicken with the sauce spooned over the top.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
